headline: Japan’s Automakers Align the Parts Beneath
lede: Toyota, Nissan, and Honda will standardize steel, plastics, resin, and wiring requirements across their supplier networks. The first changes arrive next year, aimed at lowering costs without flattening the identities of the cars themselves.

headline: A New Pill Presses Pancreatic Cancer
lede: The KRAS inhibitor daraxonrasib made tumors undetectable in roughly one patient in twelve during an early trial. The result is consequential for a disease with few options, but longer follow-up must determine whether the benefit lasts.

headline: Linux Boots Inside WebAssembly
lede: Compile the real kernel. Boot Alpine or Debian in the browser. Unkernel brings filesystems, networking, and device support along for the ride, trading some CPU speed for a remarkably portable Linux environment.

headline: The Riemann Hypothesis Enters Lean
lede: A 17-million-line Lean library presents a machine-checked proof of the Riemann Hypothesis. Independent checking tools and the Lean kernel validate the formal artifact; the next scholarly task is to recover the mathematics beneath it.

headline: When Conflict Advice Changes With Gender
lede: GAMA-Bench mirrors 1,298 intimate and public conflicts to test how language models judge identical conduct. Across ten systems, male actors drew more punitive framing while female actors received more therapeutic language, a result shaped by both model training and the study’s synthetic limits.
pullquote: A model’s moral tone can change before its verdict does.

headline: Build the Sandwich You Always Wanted
lede: Spread, stack, rotate, and photograph an open-faced sandwich in the browser. Sandwich Simulator turns a tiny piece of direct manipulation into a cheerful playground for toppings, memories, and 87-pickle experiments.

headline: Smaller Models, Carefully Measured
lede: LookAtMyQuant allocates bits where quantization does the least damage, then tests the result against a fixed memory budget. Its compact Inkling and Qwen builds point toward capable local models that fit in ordinary machines—provided the benchmarks hold up.

headline: Turn an EPUB Folder Into a Library
lede: Mayberry makes a private OPDS branch from books stored on your own computer. Encrypted outbound tunnels avoid port forwarding, while anonymous library cards let friends browse a shared catalog without handing the collection to a central host.

headline: A Handbook for Reading Riemann’s Lean
lede: This growing set of PDF and EPUB volumes translates formal Lean code into definitions, lemmas, and mathematical commentary. It is a useful map through difficult terrain, but neither the handbook nor the full project yet serves as independent verification.

headline: Why Ten Thousand Pounds Must Explode
lede: Aging lead azide at an Iowa ammunition facility has recrystallized into a form too dangerous to move or treat. The Army’s controlled detonation is the least-bad option, with water misting, barriers, weather constraints, and environmental monitoring set against the risk of a larger accident.
